title: 27 Oct–Care for Elderly @ J J Dharamshala

photo.alt: 27 Oct–Care for Elderly @ J J Dharamshala

summary: On 27th October we donated various items sponsored by Rtn PP Shyam & Usha Lohiya for senior citizens of J J Dharamshala bringing comfort, care and Diwali happiness to the elderly.
description:
On 27th October we donated various items sponsored by Rtn PP Shyam & Usha Lohiya for senior citizens of J J Dharamshala bringing comfort, care and Diwali happiness to the elderly. Items such as 60 gowns, 40 banyans, 40 towels, napkins, undergarments, 100 tetrapack milk boxes, 80 toiletry items, 18 packets of maza mango drink and malkist biscuits were distributed. Blouses with Rs 5,000 towards stitching charges of 100 blouses were also sponsored. The morning came alive with interactive games organised by Ushaji which Rtn Reshma Shah and her friend Mr Dignesh entertained the residents with games including musical chairs. Bollywood dancing and garba brought smiles and excitement and some residents delighted us with songs of their own. A touching moment was when Anthony proudly gifted us a book of his paintings. Listening to their life stories moved us deeply. Their happiness and warmth of their farewell touched our hearts.
Attended by 8 Rotarians.
Beneficiaries 60
Project cost Rs 40,000
